definitionZh: 标记启动 CSS 属性指向在元素路径的第一个顶点上绘制的标记;即在其起始顶点上. 标记必须是使用 SVG 元素定义的,只能以 URL 值来引用 。 CSS属性的值凌驾于SVG中标记启动属性的任何值.
sourceDefinition: The marker-start CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first vertex of the element's path; that is, at its starting vertex. The marker must have been defined using an SVG element, and can only be referenced with a urlvalue value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start attribute in the SVG.
